reviews.text: I really like the professionalism, friendliness, and prices of this veterinary clinic.
Dr. Fátima was impeccable and very attentive. I went to have my dog ​​euthanized and received the utmost care.

The worst veterinarian we’ve ever encountered. From the start, all she wanted was to sedate my cat, calling him “unkind” instead of taking the time to handle him properly. Not only did she fail at treating him and recommend expensive food that only made him sick, but she even made a serious mistake on his passport, almost preventing us from flying. I had to pay for a new passport simply because she wouldn’t make the slightest effort to fix her own error. For the sake of pets, I honestly believe this person should consider another career.

We live in Sintra, but whenever our dog needs it, we go to Dr. Maria do Carmo. They are very competent and professional; the veterinarian clearly comes from the "old school," she knows what she's doing, and she dedicates herself to animals out of love, not for money like many others we find elsewhere. She identified dermatitis that my dog ​​had for years but that no one had ever told us about. It was treated with possible medication and she is doing well. We've had our Lira for 17 years and she's still full of energy. I always recommend this clinic to friends. The prices are quite affordable. Come to this clinic, you won't regret it. Thank you very much to the whole team!

Excellent, I recommend it to everyone.
Total excellence with my cats for 13 years.

...the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to. Even today, a year and a half later, I remember the excellent treatment they gave my Zack. He arrived with lung cancer, short of breath, they wanted to euthanize him, but I wouldn't let them. I searched for a clinic and, out of nowhere, this one appeared! They did everything to remove the fluid from his lungs, gave him six months, he lived another year with a great quality of life, and when he returned for euthanasia, he passed away peacefully... Eternally grateful for all the care given to my old Zack. Thank you, Doctor and team!

I have a kitten that, about 3 years ago at the zoo, they told me I had to put down because she had a tumor on her belly. At the Ben vet clinic, the doctor operated on her, and I still have her as a companion at home; she's part of the family. Thank you very much.
